title: Postmark
$comment: Consensus’s record, and the only object this document calls a postmark (§2.2, P-2). An envelope has one postmark per chunk; where one stands for the envelope it is chunk 0’s (§5.7). OBSERVED object (§5.1): nobody authors it; this schema describes rather than constrains. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.
